title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: suspension for missed employer payments
content:
The Corporate Wellness Partnership suspends a corporate wellness enrollment once the employer's master account has missed the tier's number of consecutive billing cycles, for any tier where automatic suspension on employer nonpayment applies. For a tier where automatic suspension on employer nonpayment does not apply, a missed payment does not by itself move the enrollment to a suspended lifecycle status under this basis.

Under this policy's original basis, a flat late-payment fee was added to the employer's master account after the tier's grace period following a missed payment. That clause is no longer in force: the current basis for assessing a late-payment fee — including how many missed cycles it covers and how it is sized — is stated in a separate document.

The remaining clause of this policy stays in force: dues continue to be billed against an enrollment while it remains suspended, so that the employer's master account continues to reflect the true amount owed rather than pausing while the enrollment is inactive.

superseded_clauses: a late_payment_fee_usd is added to the employer's master account after late_payment_grace_days of a missed payment
